The text of a proposal made from the edition: the edit button of a paragraph opens a new topic on the talk page of its page, filled in with this text (1: the page, 2: the id of the paragraph, 3: its TeX, 4: the proposed TeX, 5: the reason, 6: the change in a few words). Once the proposal is accepted, an editor applies it with <code>wikitex.py apply-proposal</code>, which uses the id of the paragraph and the proposed text. The split signature at the end becomes four tildes in the new topic. See [[How to contribute#Proposing a change|How to contribute]].</noinclude>
